thread.title: Apple Inc. (AAPL) Given Consensus Recommendation of “Buy” by Brokerages

author: ABMN Staff
title: Apple Inc. (AAPL) Given Consensus Recommendation of “Buy” by Brokerages
text:
Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has received a consensus recommendation of “Buy” from the fifty-two brokerages that are covering the company, Marketbeat reports. Three equities research analysts have rated the stock with a sell recommendation, nineteen have given a hold recommendation and thirty have assigned a buy recommendation to the company. The average 12 month target price among analysts that have updated their coverage on the stock in the last year is $221.51.
Several analysts recently commented on AAPL shares. New Street Research cut Apple from a “neutral” rating to a “sell” rating in a report on Monday, August 20th. Bank of America upped their target price on Apple from $250.00 to $256.00 and gave the company a “buy” rating in a report on Monday, September 10th. Morgan Stanley upped their target price on Apple from $245.00 to $247.00 and gave the company an “overweight” rating in a report on Thursday, September 13th. Macquarie set a $214.00 target price on Apple and gave the company a “buy” rating in a report on Wednesday, August 15th. Finally, Goldman Sachs Group restated a “neutral” rating and issued a $240.00 target price on shares of Apple in a report on Thursday, September 13th.
